_: The Core Collection's interface, beside core.css: which component draws each control (SPEC 5f), the collection's tint, and its units' groups by what they act on (SPEC 5d). A unit's own key overrides its kind's default.

groups.title: Along time
groups.what: Draw on earlier positions: each position's stream at their layer gets something of the positions before it (an echo, a decaying average, a replay).

groups.title: On the stream's size
groups.what: Act on the length of the stream's vector and leave its direction alone, so they do not depend on the coordinates the stream is written in.

groups.title: Coordinate by coordinate
groups.what: Act on each of the stream's coordinates separately (squash, round, zero or clamp them), so what they do depends on the coordinates the stream is written in.

groups.title: Along directions and principal bands
groups.what: Act along chosen directions of the stream, or bands of its principal directions measured on the unchanged model.

groups.title: Inside a block
groups.what: Act inside the blocks rather than between them: on what attention and the MLP write, or on the MLP's neurons.

groups.title: Meters
groups.what: Read the model and change nothing.
